sources.name: Greenhouse job boards
sources.notes: List is 59 KB for 83 jobs; content=true is 845 KB, so bodies are fetched per job at /jobs/{id} only for postings that survive the metadata gate. No ETag offered when checked. A wrong token is 404.

sources.name: Lever job boards
sources.notes: One request returns descriptions, workplaceType and a two-letter country. The only platform of the three that returned an ETag and answered a conditional request with 304.

sources.name: Ashby job boards
sources.notes: One request returns descriptionPlain, workplaceType and isRemote. isListed=false postings are skipped. A wrong token returns a plain-text 404, not JSON.

sources.name: RemoteOK
sources.notes: Bare array whose FIRST element is a legal notice rather than a job.

sources.name: We Work Remotely
sources.notes: RSS, not JSON. Title is "Company: Role" and is the only place the company name appears.

sources.name: Remotive
sources.notes: jobs[] alongside two legal-notice keys. candidate_required_location is a restriction, not a location.

sources.name: Working Nomads
sources.notes: Bare array; tags is a comma-separated string rather than a list.

sources.name: Adzuna
sources.notes: Verified live 2026-08-20. Covers 19 countries; a selected country outside that set is reported rather than dropped silently. Country x term queries are capped per run and rotate, so a day covers what an hour cannot.

sources.name: Jooble
sources.notes: Verified live 2026-08-20. POST with a JSON body; the key is in the URL path and never reaches an error line. Location x term queries capped and rotating.

sources.name: Careerjet
sources.notes: Verified live 2026-08-20, with TWO CORRECTIONS. The endpoint is plain HTTP: it refuses TLS outright (connection refused on 443) and answers on port 80, so the affiliate key travels in plaintext. And it rejects an undeclared caller with 403 and the body 'Undeclared referrer. Please add a Referer header so we know who is calling this API and from which page.' - so the connector declares itself with a Referer naming the project, which is the same honest-identification rule as the User-Agent. Locale x term queries capped and rotating.

sources.name: Reed
sources.notes: Verified live 2026-08-20. HTTP Basic with the key as username; dd/mm/yyyy dates. Only asked when the saved search includes the UK.

sources.name: USAJobs
sources.notes: Verified live 2026-08-20. Needs the key AND the registered email, which goes in the User-Agent header.

sources.name: The Muse
sources.notes: CORRECTION to Appendix A, which lists this as free-key: the public endpoint answers with no key at all. A key raises the rate limit rather than unlocking access.
